items.name: slider
items.title: Zen Sand Slider
items.description: A slider that is a bamboo rake in a tray of sand. Drag right and its four tines cut grooves and push a little heap of sand ahead of it; pull back and its back drags the sand flat again. One file of about 170 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-slider>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Zen Sand Slider is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /zen-sand-ui/slider.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sand-slider value="40" label="Volume"></sand-slider>. Read el.value; it fires input while it moves and change when it comes to rest. min, max and step work; with a name it is sent with its form. More: https://zen-sand-ui.vercel.app

items.name: toggle
items.title: Zen Sand Toggle
items.description: A switch that is a river stone in a tray of raked sand. Switch it on and the stone glides along, parting the sand into a wake, and uncovers a power symbol it had pressed into the sand where it was resting. One file of about 170 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-toggle>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Zen Sand Toggle is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /zen-sand-ui/toggle.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sand-toggle label="Focus mode"></sand-toggle>. Read el.checked and listen for change. Works in forms with a name. More: https://zen-sand-ui.vercel.app

items.name: signature
items.title: Zen Sand Signature
items.description: A signature pad of smoothed sand, written in with a stick that cuts like a brush: linger and the line is wide and deep, hurry and it thins. The sand heaps up along the line. Clear sends a rake across that smooths it all away. One file of about 170 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-signature>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Zen Sand Signature is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /zen-sand-ui/signature.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sand-signature name="signature"></sand-signature>. el.empty, el.undo(), el.clear() and el.toDataURL() give you the signature as ink on a transparent PNG; it fires input after each stroke. With a name its form gets the PNG. More: https://zen-sand-ui.vercel.app

items.name: thinking
items.title: Zen Sand Thinking
items.description: An AI agent's working state as a rock in a round tray of sand that rakes itself. Thinking draws rings round the rock, searching draws spokes, using a tool draws lines that flow round it like water, and writing draws dashes like lines of text. One file of about 370 KB with its sand engine and sounds inside it, no dependencies, defines <sand-thinking>.
items.author: Justin Finkelman <https://github.com/finktheartist>
items.docs: Zen Sand Thinking is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /zen-sand-ui/thinking.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <sand-thinking state="thinking"></sand-thinking> and set el.state to thinking, searching, tool, writing or idle as your agent works. It is a status region, so the state is read out. More: https://zen-sand-ui.vercel.app
